facts.fact: Eltumi Partners states Libya passed Law No 6 of 2022 on Electronic Transactions in October 2022, governing the validity and regulation of electronic transactions.

facts.fact: Eltumi Partners states the government has not yet published the executive regulation to the e-Transactions Law and that its applicability is untested.
